description.value: Once per day, in a moment of real danger, gain a bonus to initiative as the borrowed fragment's old instincts fire before you consciously react.

cinderfall.incomplete: Granting a new limited-use activated action/reaction has no rule-element hook in real pf2e -- confirmed corpus-wide this pass (Reactive Shield itself ships rules: []). and states no numeric value for the initiative bonus. The card states a bonus/effect but gives no numeric value or formula to build a rule element from without inventing one.
